manifest.name: Flashcards
manifest.description: Flashcards with spaced repetition: decks of cards (front, back, a note), tap to flip, grade Again / Good / Easy, daily streaks. Fits: learning words, facts, definitions, quizzes, study.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

sides.desc: label on the front, label on the back

mono.desc: true only if answers are code

notes_for_juli: app_name: 1-2 words for the subject. One deck per topic the person names (1-3 decks), 8-20 cards each, all CORRECT facts; if unsure of a fact, leave the card out. sides = the two short labels (e.g. WORD / MEANING). note = a short example or tip, or leave it out. Pick one icon per deck. Example: {"app_name": "Birds", "accent": "#274b9f", "session_size": 8, "decks": [{"name": "Garden birds", "sides": ["BIRD", "FACT"], "icon": "leaf", "hue": "#2a8c7e", "cards": [{"front": "Robin", "back": "Red breast, sings all winter", "note": "Often follows gardeners"}, {"front": "Wren", "back": "Tiny, loud, cocked tail", "note": "One of the smallest birds"}, {"front": "Blackbird", "back": "Males black with an orange bill", "note": "Females are brown"}, {"front": "Blue tit", "back": "Blue cap, yellow belly", "note": "Uses nest boxes"}]}]}
